'''Langsheng''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]], patrolling the Commercial District.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Langsheng:''' There's nothing quite like being on duty in a bustling commercial area. All that time I spent applying for this job feels worth it.
:{{DIcon}} You volunteered to come here?
:'''Langsheng:''' Yeah. I'm not someone with great ambitions. Just wanna live a peaceful life.
:'''Langsheng:''' Look around. The business's booming here and it's all thanks to the best Patrollers like us!
:{{DIcon}} Indeed, that's true.
:'''Langsheng:''' Haha, thanks. If you ever run into trouble, no need to argue.
:'''Langsheng:''' Just say my name and everything will be smoothed over.
:'''Langsheng:''' Don't worry. I'm a man of connections.
{{Dialogue End}}
